verdict.rationale: DPMA is a patent and trade mark office offering search databases and e-filing tools. A service like this could plausibly offer programmatic or headless access, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows web portals (DPMAdirektWeb, DPMAregister, DEPATISnet) and downloadable desktop filing software (DPMAdirektPro), with nothing documenting a headless mode, API, or CI-friendly automation. The register host's robots.txt also disallows crawling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
